name: PoE2 native weapon and skill switching on a fresh account
priority: Protect the user's current PC from an unquantified hardware-ban risk
prerequisites: Fresh account with its own verified PoE2 entitlement; no purchase made by this package
A suitable character with two equipped weapon sets and two already-available compatible skills
Recovery of that test character's current game bindings before any changes
Confirmed use of individually triggered inputs and the native game UI
No account passwords, raw hardware identifiers or private account details in public records

native_test_cases.action: Use the native Skills panel to assign skill A to weapon set I and skill B to II
native_test_cases.expect: Assignments persist in the game UI

native_test_cases.action: Manually press the key for skill B while set I is active
native_test_cases.expect: The game selects II and uses skill B if its normal requirements are met

native_test_cases.action: Manually press the key for skill A while II is active
native_test_cases.expect: The game selects I and uses skill A

native_test_cases.action: Manually use a skill enabled for both sets
Manually use X / R2 COMBAT button 37
native_test_cases.expect: Weapon-set toggle without a scripted cast

native_test_cases.action: Check one main skill and its Ctrl partner individually
native_test_cases.expect: Distinct intended abilities; no duplicate or unintended output

native_test_cases.action: Check the UI after a normal area transition and later relog
native_test_cases.expect: Prepared bindings and assignments persist; record any game-specific bug

prohibited_sequence_test.reason: A fresh account on this PC does not prove hardware isolation or establish enforcement safety
prohibited_sequence_test.offline_coverage: Weapon equip, gem replacement, assignment, preflight, partial cancellation and item conservation in a self-contained model

stop_conditions: No clear recovery for a change
interpretation: Passing native tests would verify function only. No ban during a test is not proof that any prohibited macro is safe.
